lines.text: After this, Job opened his mouth and cursed the day of his birth.
Job asks that the day of his birth turn to darkness and that God above disregard it.
Job wants the night cursed by those prepared to rouse Behemoth.
Job says he would be at rest with kings and counselors, or with prophets who had gold.
Job sighs when food is put before him, and his groans pour out like water.
